scripts.build: npm run codegen && tsc && npm run copy:prisma
scripts.db:start: docker run -d --name codified-architecture-db -e POSTGRES_USER=postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=codified_architecture -p 5432:5432 -v codified-architecture-postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data --restart unless-stopped postgres:16-alpine || docker start codified-architecture-db
scripts.db:remove: docker stop codified-architecture-db && docker rm codified-architecture-db
